screenshotCapture.reason: The visible model, execution mode and account plan were captured in the semantic DOM before prompt submission.

captureMethod: DOM-scoped reconstruction of ChatGPT's read-only CodeMirror editor by scrolling the visible conversation container and collecting rendered lines with absolute line positions.
captureNote: The initially visible CodeMirror DOM window ended after the first current-owner object and appeared truncated. A narrow repair was sent before the editor's full virtualized contents were reconstructed. Complete DOM-scoped reconstruction proved the initial response was valid JSON; the repair returned a byte-for-byte identical JSON object. One repair was used and no second repair was sent.
